note: Hand-written, language-neutral. The declared home of the Redis keyspace prefix (ADR-0036, C-03, C-04). Read by txnet-backend/shared-core/src/lib/redis/keyspace.contract.spec.ts and auth-handler/internal/config/keyspace_contract_test.go. Change a value here and both sides go red until they agree. Bumping `version` is a forced logout of every session on the platform — that is what the field is for, and it means every service and auth-handler deploy together.

keys.note: Key names, after the prefix. Only the families more than one language builds are declared here — auth-handler builds `session:` in Go and gateway-service and auth-service build it in TypeScript, so a disagreement is silent: the lookup misses, and a miss is read as `revoked`. The tenant-derived families are TypeScript-only and live in shared-core/src/lib/redis/keys.ts alone.

prefixCasesNote: The last two are the shapes that split the keyspace if only one language normalises. A trailing colon in REDIS_KEY_NAMESPACE is the operator typo this file exists to make harmless.
